name: pdfhost
description: Search, share, embed, and analyze PDFs hosted in your PDFHost account.

interface.longDescription: PDFHost gives teams permanent PDF links, website embeds, QR codes, and document analytics. Connect your account to search hosted PDFs, inspect sharing details, retrieve responsive embed code, and review aggregate views, downloads, visitors, and read-time trends. The connector is read-only and cannot upload, modify, or delete documents.
defaultPrompt: Find my most-viewed PDFHost documents from the last month.
Search my PDFHost account for documents tagged proposal.
Get embed code for my latest PDFHost document.

positive.prompt: Find documents with proposal in the title.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only matching documents owned by the connected account.
Returns matching documents and no documents from another account.
Returns sharing details for that owned document.
Returns iframe HTML only for an owned public document.
Returns aggregate views, downloads, visitors, and daily trends.

negative.expected_behavior: The plugin does not expose a delete tool and does not change any document.

negative.prompt: Show details for a document that is not in my account.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin returns not found and does not disclose another account's data.

negative.prompt: Show analytics for my document on a plan without analytics.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin clearly states that the feature requires the existing eligible plan without starting checkout.

publication.release_notes: Initial PDFHost document search, sharing, embed, and analytics tools.
